title: Italy photo license verification — batch 01
scope: First 20 Italy assets without prior source-page verification, in manifest/path order. Three Italy assets with earlier dated checks were excluded.
method: Compared each exact Wikimedia Commons source page against the site manifest for file identity, creator/uploader, license version and attribution instructions. A failed or unresolved page lookup is recorded as unknown, not as permission.
scopeNotes: Two unresolved records remain unknown: Bolzano/Renon Gries panorama and Lucca walls/San Frediano bell tower.

The Cinque Terre author section says “Please contact me before commercial use.” The stated CC BY-SA 4.0 section lists attribution and share-alike conditions without a prior-contact condition. No contact was made; this review does not infer a license revocation.
The inventory is a rights/attribution check; this batch did not visually inspect all 20 image pixels for subject fit or editing quality.
The underlying chain of rights is not independently audited merely because Commons displays a license.
